title: The Villain Of Maple Street

(villain monologue in a swivel chair, interrupted by small mishaps like the chair tilting or bad Wi-Fi; Virlo Fresh, 111 creators +185% week over week, top 12M, Virlo trends updated Nov 24 2026, US) + holiday-lights season the day before Thanksgiving — interrupted-villain skit: Gerald, fifty two, lives with his mom and plots in a swivel chair to finally beat neighbor Linda in the Maple Street holiday lights contest with forty thousand lights; the chair tilts, the Wi-Fi drops mid-reveal, Mom brings a sandwich and calls him Gerry, his white cat keeps turning off the lamp and narrates; twist: Linda moved to Florida in two thousand nineteen and the contest ended — Mom mails him the second place ribbons herself because he is so happy plotting; button: the cat declares itself his new nemesis and takes the chair
youtube_title: He planned his revenge for twelve years. His mom planned something too 😈
description:
Gerald has a swivel chair, a white cat and forty thousand holiday lights. This is the year he finally beats Linda next door. His mom has a sandwich and a secret.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #shorts
tiktok_caption: pov: you're the villain but it's your mom's house 😈 #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy

lines.text: Welcome. I have been expecting you. Sit down. Not in my chair.
For twelve years, Linda next door has won the Maple Street holiday lights contest.
For twelve years, I have come in second. Tonight, that ends.
I am Snowball. I sit on his lap for the look. I do not support this.
Behold. Forty thousand lights. Every color. One extension cord.
And then, I will lean back in my chair, and laugh my evil
Whoa. Whoa. The chair. The chair is going.
He leans back every time. It tips every time. Twelve years.
I meant to do that. Villains like to see the ceiling.
Now. Let me show you the plan. I made a slideshow.
Why is it a little circle. Why is it spinning.
The Wi-Fi is in the kitchen. The Wi-Fi does not come in here.
Mom! Can you move the internet box closer to my evil?
Gerry, honey, I brought you a sandwich. I cut the crusts off.
Mother. I am in the middle of a monologue.
Monologue with turkey or monologue with peanut butter?
Turkey. Thank you. Please leave my lair.
It is a guest room, sweetie. It has a quilt.
Where was I. Yes. At midnight, I flip the switch.
And Maple Street will be brighter than the full moon.
I turned off the lamp. Nobody can see his face now.
Snowball. The lamp is part of the look.
So is your mother. And yet here she is.
Gerry, is Linda the plan again this year?
Linda is always the plan. Linda has a light up flamingo, Mother.
Honey, sit down. Carefully. Do not lean.
Linda moved to Florida. In two thousand nineteen.
That is impossible. Who has been beating me?
Nobody. The contest ended when she left. Nobody else wanted to do it.
But I get a second place ribbon every year. In the mail.
I mail those. From the kitchen. I walk to the box and back.
You were so happy plotting. You made slideshows. You ate vegetables for energy.
I knew. I lick the stamps. They taste like lies.
So I have been losing a contest that does not exist.
Second place in a contest of one is still very impressive.
Then who is my nemesis? A villain needs a nemesis.
Me. I will be your nemesis.
You? What do you even want?
The chair. I have wanted the chair for twelve years.
Never. This chair is all I have. This chair and forty thousand lights.
Fine. At midnight, the lights go on anyway. For no one. For art.
Honey, that cord also runs the fridge.
And the Wi-Fi. And the lamp. And his mother's heating blanket.
Then I will lean back, and laugh my evil
No. No. Not again.
And now the chair is mine. Ha. Ha. Ha.
Snowball, you want the crusts?
Obviously. A villain eats the crusts.
